answer: Picture donations pooling like a quiet lagoon: in quadratic funding many small independent givers get amplified matching, so headcount seems to buy influence. We resist sybils by clustering contributions by shared funding origin and capping each cluster's matched amount. One operator splitting a budget across a willow-spray of fake donors reaps no amplification; their fable of a crowd collapses to a single capped voice, while genuinely diverse backers keep full quadratic weight.
